articles.title: Oil Price Today (October 29): Crude oil dips to $113 as diplomatic talks outweigh infra attacks. Can oil fall further?
articles.description: Crude oil price : In light of recent diplomatic talks surrounding potential U.S. military engagements with Iran, oil prices have taken a dip. These crude prices remain sensitive to the fluctuating situation marked by ongoing regional conflicts and the threat of further military interventions. Despite Iran's openness to negotiations, escalating hostilities from the Houthi faction targeting Saudi Arabia add to the uncertainty.

articles.title: India Closely Monitoring Tehran Talks Involving Pakistan, Says Centre
articles.description: The statement comes amid reports of discussions in Tehran aimed at de-escalating regional tensions and securing a ceasefire between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthi group, with Iran reportedly facilitating negotiations.
